The '''''Bloodblade''''' was a [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]] owned by [[Jostero]], [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Silestro Privateers]], a group of [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].
